description: Find BJJ gyms near a US city, neighborhood, or ZIP. Defaults: open to drop-ins, classes today. Returns drop-in policy, visitor fee when known, matching class times, and online booking (reservePrice, reserveUrl) when the gym takes reservations.

day.description: Restrict to this weekday or tomorrow. Overrides today

drop_ins.description: Only gyms marked Drop-ins (known welcome or a listed visitor/open-mat price). Default true

kinds.description: Filter to Gi, No-Gi, and/or open mat

q.description: City, neighborhood, address, or ZIP, same as the OpenMapp search box

today.description: Only gyms with a listed class or open mat today. Default true

name: find_gyms
title: Find BJJ gyms
